subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

__Not only the manager give me a refund__, but he also offered me a 50% discount on my next meal.

options.text: Not only do the manager give me a refund,
Not only did the manager gave me a refund,
Not only did the manager give me a refund,

solution:
The correct answer is: **Not only did the manager give me a refund,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence "**Not only the manager give me a refund**" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• In English, when using the structure "**not only...but also,**" the auxiliary verb should come after "**not only**" for proper inversion, as in "**Not only did**."
 
• So, the **corrected sentence** should be: "*Not only did the manager give me a refund, but he also offered me a 50% discount on my next meal.*"
 
• This construction follows proper English grammar rules by inverting the subject and auxiliary verb after "not only" to form a parallel structure with "but also."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
